placements.why: The envelope is explicitly about observatory calibration — calibrating the Kestrelwood spectrograph at 88.4 MHz and verifying against June reference plates. No existing strata category covers calibration work; this content establishes one.
placements.title: Instrument calibration as a tracked organizational practice
placements.theme: Calibration of observatory instruments is performed at a target frequency, verified against reference plates, and recorded as a distinct activity.

placements.title: Spectrograph calibration established and verified against reference plates
placements.theme: The Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz is established and holds across the full observing band when verified against June reference plates.
placements.why: Quill Ashgrove asserts the spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verifies it against June reference plates across the full observing band; Xena ExpertGH records the key decisions (instrument and calibration parameters). All five segments support the thematic subject of the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration status — a subject future envelopes can continue to feed with recalibrations, new verifications, or band-extension results.
